reconfigure_door.title: Entrance devices
reconfigure_door.description: Leave the lock event entity empty to run review-only: the integration then keys every activity off Frigate person reviews and never creates a door cycle.

error.invalid_auth: Native authentication requires a username and password
error.invalid_door_mapping: Door mapping values overlap or are invalid
error.door_lock_required: Door contact and doorbell require a lock event entity
error.llm_incomplete: Base URL and model are both required

test_connection.title: Test connection
test_connection.description: Result using the saved settings: model {model}, {seconds}s, {tokens} tokens. A successful reply means the URL, key and model name all work.

error.invalid_provider_response: The provider replied in an unexpected format
error.provider_http_401: The provider rejected the API key
error.provider_http_404: The model or endpoint was not found

vision_not_configured.title: Vision provider not configured
vision_not_configured.description: Entry {entry_id} has no vision provider settings, so activities are never analysed.

provider_unavailable.title: Vision provider unreachable
provider_unavailable.description: Entry {entry_id} cannot reach the configured vision provider.

door_mapping_invalid.title: Door mapping invalid
door_mapping_invalid.description: Entry {entry_id} rejected the configured lock event.

door_open_too_long.title: Front door open too long
door_open_too_long.description: Entry {entry_id} received no close event for 30 minutes, so the open door cycle was closed as failed. Check whether the door is ajar and whether the lock still reports close events.

storage_corrupt.title: Stored state invalid
storage_corrupt.description: Entry {entry_id} stopped to protect persisted state.

media_cleanup_failed.title: Media cleanup failed
media_cleanup_failed.description: Entry {entry_id} could not clean an evidence file.

delivery_outcome_unknown.title: Delivery outcome unknown
delivery_outcome_unknown.description: Entry {entry_id} will not resend the notification.
